newsitem.title: USA: U.S. blue chips in positive ground in late trade.
newsitem.headline: U.S. blue chips in positive ground in late trade.

text.p: U.S. blue chips pushed into positive territory in late afternoon trading on Friday, turning their backs on a weak bond market.

Traders said a strong rebound in in technology stocks coupled with strength in other sectors, including transports, boosted the broader market. Short covering ahead of the weekend was also cited as a factor.
The Dow rose 39 points, or 0.6 percent, to 6516. Advancing issues took a narrow lead over decliners on the Big Board.
Leading the way was the Nasdaq composite, which shot up 21 points, or 1.7 percent to 1234.
